title: Visual catalog card
responsibility: Shows a page or component by its own screenshot and linked name with the shared linked Used In footer, owning its layout in every list.

inputs.name: ExplorerPageCard.row
inputs.description: One page or visual component: its id, name and Used In consumers. Its other row facts stay on its detail page.

inputs.name: ExplorerPageCard.shot
inputs.description: The entity's own usable screenshot or null, never another's. Missing media or image-load failure shows an explicit no-screenshot gap. A page's link title names its captured or reused commit; a component card shows no provenance.

inputs.name: ExplorerPageCard.nav
inputs.description: The selected branch, commit and navigation actions; opening the card keeps that scope.

inputs.name: ExplorerPageCard.category
inputs.description: Pages keep their title and screenshot as one link, plus the shared grouped usage footer. Components show their screenshot, linked title and the same footer as one unheaded list of at most three consumer links, ending in an ellipsis only when more exist, with identical layout in catalogs and relationship tabs.

inputs.name: ExplorerPageCard.verification
inputs.description: Still accepted, never shown: every card keeps verification on the entity detail page.

inputs.name: ExplorerPageCard.lens
inputs.description: Revision-scoped screenshot evidence for linked consumers.

outputs.name: ExplorerPageCard
outputs.description: One card with the entity's own screenshot or gap, linked name and shared Used In consumer links and previews, bound to the selected revision; a component card lists its first three consumers flat, then an ellipsis for any more. No description, Contains, status, verification, provenance caption or Open button.
